integrity: Physical rates and stationary generator are explicitly specified, and finite symbolic computations are reproducible with a standalone exact-arithmetic checker; originality is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite four-site reservoir-driven process at stated waiting times and mean reservoir density; open neighborhood guarantees existence, not uniqueness. No large-system, typical-disorder, current-fluctuation, or general-sufficiency theorem.
title: A unique finite-drive rectification zero in a four-site disordered exclusion chain
